build.name: pip install the acquired source (+ pinned deps)
build.cmd: pip install -q  . 2>&1 | grep -v -i 'notice\|warning' | tail -2; python -c 'import sys; print(sys.version.split()[0])'

runs.name: schedule (Techne harness, oracle-backed; same-container install + run)

notes: Oracle: without jitter 1000 clients share ONE wait value at attempt 6 (they re-collide); with full jitter the values spread (distinct >= 20).
